exclusions.source_text: Creatinine: Calculated clearance ≥30 mL/min using Cockcault-Groft equation
Direct bilirubin ≤1.5 × institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤3 × institutional ULN
AL Amyloidosis Cardiac stage I, II or IIIa disease based on the 2013 European Modification of the 2004 Standard Mayo Clinic Staging in participants with advanced cardiac involvement
exclusions.threshold: Mayo cardiac stage I, II or IIIa

exclusions.source_text: Women who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant while enrolled in this study
Participants seropositive for the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
Participants with an active malignancy (including lymphoma) with the following exceptions

Participants with an active malignancy (including lymphoma) with the following exceptions: adequately treated basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, or in situ cervical cancer; adequately treated stage I cancer from which the patient is currently in remission and has been for over 2 years
exclusions.threshold: active malignancy; stage I remission >2 years allowed

exclusions.source_text: History of acute coronary syndrome or uncontrolled ventricular arrhythmias within 3 months prior to screening.
Evidence of LV systolic dysfunction as defined by LVEF is \< 30% by echocardiogram at Screening per site cardiology interpretation.
QT corrected by Fridericia (QTcF) is \> 550 msec on Screening ECG unless they have a PPM/ICD implanted.
NYHA class IV symptoms or participants with acute decompensation of congestive heart failure.

Have history of sustained ventricular tachycardia or aborted ventricular fibrillation or a history of atrioventricular nodal or sinoatrial nodal dysfunction if a permanent pacemaker (PPM) or implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) is not placed.
